closedFindings.resolution: Corrected field verified. The failed first summary is retained; the final sealed revision was rerun in both TEMP environments and all ten scenarios met expectations.

independentChecks.pathBoundary: Native canonicalization and directory/file identities accept equivalent aliases while rejecting out-of-bound parents, cwd/leaf links, hardlinks, premature output and observed replacements. Schema content and original CLI parameters remain bound.
independentChecks.refusalAccounting: Before-dispatch schema refusal produced one admitted attempt with known zero usage and usageSource=not_dispatched; external-output and raw-audit hardlink refusals retained raw/canonical diagnostics and stages. Hardlink raw output was not read; known synthetic usage was retained.

limitations: One actual file-symlink test was skipped because Windows denied creation with EPERM; junction and hardlink cases ran.
Path checks do not guarantee atomic protection against concurrent filesystem mutation by a process with equal permissions.
All model replies and usage in this repair stage are synthetic; model quality, availability, live cost and human acceptance remain unmeasured.
The proposed 36 attempts and 700000-token stop threshold are not authorized by this review; the token threshold is not a provider-enforced hard cap.
